page.layout: One column of running text; a short paragraph ending the previous article at the top, then a centred article heading with a title line below it, then the body. Running head top centre, page number top left, catchword bottom right.

main_text.l: premat aquam jam factam potabilem, ubicunque
tandem edulcoretur.
Alia quoque gravis est difficultas in illa matis co-
llatione[?], quam non opinor animadvertisse[?] Scalige-
rum quamque suo loco propositam, Deo dante, re-
solvemus.
ARTICULUS V.
Quomodo aqua marina surgant in fontes.
QUO igitur vehiculo scandunt aquae maris factae
subterraneae, si quidem id Scaliger ignotavit;
Id non debuit esse obscurum ei qui viderat aquam
igne submisso per evaporationem ascendere, eandem-
que rursus obice facto-condensatam, pristina forma
recepta recidere. Est enim imis terrae penetralibus
ignis intestinus qui ut mineralia, metalla, aliaque
permulta concoquit, ita aquam subiens eandem
sursum vehit in vapores, qui si petreum retinacu-
lum inveniant, in aquam resoluti quaerunt exitum.
Quo plures autem atque copiosiores stillae ejusmo-
di ex pluribus locis in unum confluxerint, eo ube-
rior fit scaturigo.
Ad scaturiginem ergo requiritur ut ascensus va-
porum ab imo fit facilis, alioquin si impeditus, reso-
luti identidem cadunt, haud secus ac in olla videmus
fumos ab operculo retentos, resolutosque recidere.
Necesse est praeterea, ut ii vapores in altum evecti
duritie, atque densitate loci cohibeantur. Ob pri-
mam causam, terra pinguis quod renacior, ac densior
minus scaturit fontibus, sed puteis apta. Ob secun-
dam, solum arenosum minus aptum fonticulis, nisi
aliunde descendant. Quod vero saxosum est ac prae-
durum in summitate, quia inferius arenosum, vel
plures, ac faciles habet hiatus, spiracula, id solum
aquarum scatebris oportunum.

page.notes: Mostly clear. Doubtful readings: "matis" (line 1 of the second paragraph, may be a word such as "materiae" misread) and "animadvertisse" (the printed form looks like "afimadvertisse", with the "ni" faint). "facto-condensatam" has an uncertain mark between the words. "renacior" is kept as printed. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "furgant" read as "surgant", "furfum" as "sursum"). A small mark "1" sits at the very foot of the page, centred; it is not treated as a signature. The large initial Q of "QUO" is joined to the following letters.
